rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: GuardVibe provides comprehensive security scanning for AI-generated code, offering 330+ curated rules across frameworks including Next.js, Supabase, Clerk, Stripe, Prisma, tRPC, Hono, and Convex. It runs locally with zero setup — no account or API key required — and integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and VS Code. The scanner covers the entire AI-generated code journey from initial generation through deployment.
